descFull: Rust Layer-7 reverse proxy for HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3/QUIC, and WebTransport. Hybrid PQC TLS (X25519MLKEM768), three TLS modes, JA3/JA4 fingerprinting, GeoIP blocking, circuit breaking, ML-adaptive rate limiting, 11 load-balancing   algorithms, Brotli/zstd compression, ACME, OCSP stapling, Prometheus metrics, and hot-reload.
